messages.subject: Re: reciprocal overlap of reads and genomic feature
messages.subject_clean: reciprocal overlap of reads and genomic feature
messages.body_plain:
My idea was that when one of the parameters for features ('--maxNonOverlapPosFeature' or '−−fracOverlapFeature')  and one for read ('--maxNonOverlapPos' or '−−fracOverlap') will be satisfied then the read is assigned (using operator OR).

Example #2
#--maxNonOverlapPosFeature 2 --maxNonOverlapPos 2 −−fracOverlapFeature 1 −−fracOverlap 1
Here for r1 and f1 parameters--maxNonOverlapPosFeature 2 --maxNonOverlapPos 2 are both satisfied (--fracOverlap and --fracOverlapFeature are not) and that was enough according to my initial idea.

It could be set also that all of them have to be satisfied (operator AND) if it correlates more with general logic of the featureCount. And then indeed in second example the f1 and r1 do not match.

Still OR operator between parameters ('--maxNonOverlapPosFeature' or '−−fracOverlapFeature') should be preferred more than operator AND as OR would make featureCount more flexible.

In case of OR operator you can set default value for '--maxNonOverlapPosFeature' 0 and it will not interfere parameter '−−fracOverlapFeature'. (Same for '--maxNonOverlapPos' and '−−fracOverlap').
Then defaults are ['--maxNonOverlapPosFeature' 0,'−−fracOverlapFeature' 0] and reads are assigned when they have even one position overlap.

If you use operator AND for parameters ('--maxNonOverlapPosFeature','−−fracOverlapFeature') and both are by default 0 it gets more complicated. Then reads are counted only when there is exact match between reads and features. In that case to keep the current default behavior the default value for '--maxNonOverlapPosFeature' has to be infinity.

******************
There is another way how to explain or make it more clear.

The parameters '--maxNonOverlapPosFeature' and '--maxNonOverlapPos' would be like revers of '--minOverlap'. While '--minOverlap' states how many position between read and feature have to match, then my proposed parameters '--maxNonOverlapPosFeature' and '--maxNonOverlapPos' would state the maximum number of positions which do not overlap.

Is it more understandable now?

messages.subject: Does BAM input need to be sorted by name?
messages.subject_clean: Does BAM input need to be sorted by name?
messages.body_plain:
Hi so I'm trying to summarize by exon using bam from STAR aligner.  However, Star output is sorted by coordinate.  Since my reads are paired-end I would like to use the -p switch, however, I'm curious if I need to resort the BAM input by name first? or will featureCounts do this automatically?  thank you!

Alex

messages.subject: Re: Does BAM input need to be sorted by name?
messages.subject_clean: Does BAM input need to be sorted by name?
messages.body_plain: No you do not need to sort your bam files. featureCounts will do that for you automatically. featureCounts processes name-sorted and location-sorted bam files at the same speed.
